consequence.statement: the capability to configure certificate details in XFCC headers is now available; existing deployments that do not use this configuration are unaffected

original.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds support for configuring certificate details while populating the XFCC (X-Forwarded-Client-Cert) header.

decision.reason: [ev-38775be62b3e] only says Istio "Added support for configuring certificate details while populating XFCC header". That describes a new configuration option, not a change to existing behavior. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honored or changes by default, so a consequence of kind none (informational) is the reading the evidence supports. Confidence is low because the note does not explicitly say the default XFCC contents stay the same.
